title: status module broken in PowerShell
body:
#### Current Behavior
status module never kicks in because `Invoke-Starship-PreCommand` is invoked before saving `$?` and `$LASTEXITCODE`. Therefore the values are overwritten.

#### Expected Behavior
`$?` and `$LASTEXITCODE` must be saved as the first step in the prompt function so they can be passed to starship and properly restored after the prompt function.

#### Environment
- Starship version: 1.0.0
- powershell version: 7.1.4
- Operating system: Windows 10.0.22000
- Terminal emulator: vscode 1.63.0
- Git Commit Hash: b4a14e3a
- Branch/Tag: master
- Rust Version: rustc 1.57.0 (f1edd0429 2021-11-29)
- Rust channel: stable-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc debug
- Build Time: 2021-12-12 19:11:23 +01:00
#### Relevant Shell Configuration

```pwsh
Invoke-Expression (&C:\Users\mfischer\src\apps\starship\target\debug\starship.exe init powershell)
```

#### Starship Configuration

```toml

disabled = true

[conda]
ignore_base = false

[directory]

truncation_symbol = "…/"
style = "bold blue"
```
